title: A2 · Elementary
description: Talk about the past, compare things, make plans and handle everyday situations.

objectives.can_do: I can describe past experiences and events.
objectives.title: Experiencias pasadas

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor about three things you did last year.
activities.target: Last year I went to ... / I saw ... / I had ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say three irregular past forms from this unit.
activities.target: went / saw / had / did

activities.instruction: Describe a past experience of a friend, not your own.
activities.target: He/She went to ... / He/She saw ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can describe past experiences and events.

activities.instruction: On your own, tell the tutor about three things you did last year.
activities.target: Last year I went to ... / I saw ... / I had ...

options: Last year I went to France.
Last year I go to France.
Last year I going to France.
I see a great film last night.

checks.prompt: Which word is the past of 'go'?

objectives.can_do: I can talk about life experiences using the present perfect.
objectives.title: Present Perfect (introducción)

activities.instruction: Say two places you have visited and one thing you have never done.
activities.target: I have been to ... / I have never ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say when you use 'ever' and 'never'.
activities.target: ever = questions / never = negatives

activities.instruction: Say what a friend has done or has never done, not about you.
activities.target: He/She has been to ... / He/She has never ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can talk about life experiences using the present perfect.

activities.instruction: On your own, say two places you have visited and one thing you have never done.
activities.target: I have been to ... / I have never ...

options: She has never seen the sea.
She have never seen the sea.
She has never saw the sea.

objectives.can_do: I can understand people talking about past experiences.
objectives.title: Listening: el pasado

activities.instruction: Listen to someone describe a past holiday and say where they went.
activities.target: They went to ... / They visited ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say three time expressions for the past.
activities.target: yesterday / last week / ago

activities.instruction: Describe a past experience you heard about outside this lesson.
activities.target: They went to ... / They visited ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can understand people talking about past experiences.

activities.instruction: On your own, listen and say where the speaker went and when.
activities.target: They went to ... / They visited ...

checks.prompt: You hear: 'Last year I went to Italy on holiday.' Where did the speaker go?
You hear: 'I visited my grandmother two weeks ago.' When did the speaker visit their grandmother?

objectives.can_do: I can compare people, places and things.
objectives.title: Comparativos

activities.instruction: Compare your city with another city using two comparatives.
activities.target: My city is bigger than ... / more expensive than ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say how you form a comparative.
activities.target: -er than / more ... than

activities.instruction: Compare two films or books, not two cities.
activities.target: ... is more ... than ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can compare people, places and things.

activities.instruction: On your own, compare your city with another city using two comparatives.
activities.target: My city is bigger than ... / more expensive than ...

options: My city is bigger than yours.
My city is big than yours.
My city is more big than yours.
This film is more interesting than that one.
This film is interestinger than that one.
This film is more interesting that that one.

objectives.can_do: I can describe the best or worst of something.
objectives.title: Superlativos

activities.instruction: Say the best and the worst thing about your city.
activities.target: The best thing is ... / The worst thing is ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say how you form a superlative.
activities.target: the + -est / the most + adjective

activities.instruction: Say the best and worst thing about a place you have not described before.
activities.target: The best thing is ... / The worst thing is ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can describe the best or worst of something.

activities.instruction: On your own, say the best and the worst thing about your city.
activities.target: The best thing is ... / The worst thing is ...

options: This is the biggest city in the country.
This is the most biggest city.
This is bigger city in the country.

objectives.can_do: I can understand comparisons and opinions about people and places.
objectives.title: Listening: comparaciones

activities.instruction: Listen to two people compare two cities and say which one they prefer.
activities.target: They prefer ... because ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say two comparative words you just heard.
activities.target: bigger / more expensive / better / worse

activities.instruction: Describe a comparison you heard outside this lesson.
activities.target: They said ... is ... than ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can understand comparisons and opinions about people and places.

activities.instruction: On your own, listen and say which of two places the speaker prefers.
activities.target: They prefer ... because ...

checks.prompt: You hear: 'Madrid is bigger than my city, but it is also more expensive.' Which city is bigger?
You hear: 'This is the best restaurant in town.' What does the speaker think?
options: It is better than the others

objectives.can_do: I can talk about plans and intentions.
objectives.title: Planes e intenciones

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor two things you are going to do next month.
activities.target: Next month I am going to ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say how you talk about future intentions.
activities.target: going to / plan to / hope to

activities.instruction: Say what a colleague is going to do next month, not what you will do.
activities.target: He/She is going to ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can talk about plans and intentions.

activities.instruction: On your own, tell the tutor two things you are going to do next month.
activities.target: Next month I am going to ...

options: Next month I am going to start a course.
Next month I am going start a course.
Next month I going to start a course.
I plan to visit my family.
I planning to visit my family.

objectives.can_do: I can make predictions and spontaneous decisions.
objectives.title: Predicciones y decisiones

activities.instruction: Make one prediction about the weather and one spontaneous decision.
activities.target: I think it will ... / I will ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say how you make a prediction with 'will'.
activities.target: I think it will + verb

activities.instruction: Make a prediction about something you have not discussed in this unit.
activities.target: I think it will ... / probably ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can make predictions and spontaneous decisions.

activities.instruction: On your own, make one prediction and one spontaneous decision.
activities.target: I think it will ... / I will ...

objectives.can_do: I can understand people talking about future plans and predictions.
objectives.title: Listening: planes y predicciones

activities.instruction: Listen to someone talk about their plans and say what they are going to do.
activities.target: They are going to ... / They will probably ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say two ways to talk about the future.
activities.target: going to / will

activities.instruction: Describe plans you heard about outside this lesson.
activities.target: They are going to ... / They will probably ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can understand people talking about future plans and predictions.

activities.instruction: On your own, listen and say what the speaker is going to do.
activities.target: They are going to ... / They will probably ...

checks.prompt: You hear: 'I'm going to visit my family next month, and I think it will be great.' What is the speaker going to do next month?
You hear: 'It will probably rain tomorrow.' What does the speaker predict?

objectives.can_do: I can buy tickets and ask about transport.
objectives.title: Comprar billetes
concepts: How much is a ticket to ...?

activities.instruction: Buy a train ticket from the tutor.
activities.target: Can I have a return ticket to ...?

activities.instruction: Without looking, name three transport words from this unit.
activities.target: ticket / train / bus / airport

activities.instruction: Ask for a bus ticket to a city you have never visited.
activities.target: Can I have a return ticket to ...?

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can buy tickets and ask about transport.

activities.instruction: On your own, buy a train ticket from the tutor and ask the price.
activities.target: How much is a ticket to ...?

checks.prompt: Listen: 'How much is a return ticket to London?' What does he want?
Listen: 'The train leaves at ten.' What time does the train leave?

objectives.can_do: I can describe what I have to do and what I must not do.
objectives.title: Obligación

activities.instruction: Say two things you have to do before a trip.
activities.target: I have to ... / I mustn't ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say the difference between 'have to' and 'mustn't'.
activities.target: have to = obligation / mustn't = prohibition

activities.instruction: Say what a friend has to do or mustn't do before a trip, not about you.
activities.target: He/She has to ... / He/She mustn't ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can describe what I have to do and what I must not do.

activities.instruction: On your own, say two things you have to do before a trip.
activities.target: I have to ... / I mustn't ...

options: I have to buy a ticket.
I has to buy a ticket.

objectives.can_do: I can describe how I feel and give simple advice.
objectives.title: Salud y consejos

activities.instruction: Tell the tutor you feel ill and ask for advice.
activities.target: I have a headache. / You should rest.

activities.instruction: Without looking, say three words about health from this unit.
activities.target: headache / cold / tired / rest

activities.instruction: Give advice to a friend who has a cold, not to yourself.
activities.target: You should ... / You shouldn't ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can describe how I feel and give simple advice.

activities.instruction: On your own, tell the tutor you feel ill and ask for advice.
activities.target: I have a headache. / You should rest.

objectives.can_do: I can understand simple health advice.
objectives.title: Listening: consejos de salud

activities.instruction: Listen to a doctor give advice and say what the patient should do.
activities.target: The patient should ... / The patient shouldn't ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say two health words from this unit.
activities.target: headache / cold / rest

activities.instruction: Repeat health advice you heard outside this lesson.
activities.target: You should ... / You shouldn't ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can understand simple health advice.

activities.instruction: On your own, listen and say what the patient should do.
activities.target: The patient should ... / The patient shouldn't ...

checks.prompt: You hear: 'You should rest and drink more water.' What advice does the speaker give?
You hear: 'I have a headache.' What is the problem?

objectives.can_do: I can book an appointment and describe what I need.
objectives.title: Pedir cita
concepts: I'd like to make an appointment

activities.instruction: Book an appointment with the tutor and say what you need.
activities.target: I'd like to make an appointment ... / What time is good?

activities.instruction: Without looking, say two phrases to book an appointment.
activities.target: I'd like to make an appointment / What time is good?

activities.instruction: Book an appointment for a different kind of service you have not practised.
activities.target: I'd like to book ... / When is it available?

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can book an appointment and describe what I need.

activities.instruction: On your own, book an appointment with the tutor and say what you need.
activities.target: I'd like to make an appointment ... / What time is good?

options: I'd like to make an appointment, please.

objectives.can_do: I can tell a short story using linking words.
objectives.title: Contar una historia

activities.instruction: Tell a short story about a trip or a funny day.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say the linking words from this unit.
activities.target: first / then / after that / finally

activities.instruction: Tell a short story about a day you have not talked about before.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can tell a short story using linking words.

activities.instruction: On your own, tell a short story about a trip or a funny day using linking words.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

checks.prompt: Choose the correct linking word: 'First, ___ after that, we went home.'

options: We went to the beach and then we had lunch.
We go to the beach and then we had lunch.
We went to the beach and then we have lunch.

objectives.can_do: I can follow a simple story when I listen to it.
objectives.title: Listening: una historia

activities.instruction: Listen to a short story and say what happened in order.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

activities.instruction: Without looking, say three sequence words.
activities.target: first / then / finally

activities.instruction: Retell a story you heard outside this lesson, using sequence words.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can follow a simple story when I listen to it.

activities.instruction: On your own, listen to a short story and say what happened in order.
activities.target: First ... / Then ... / Finally ...

checks.prompt: You hear: 'First we went to the beach, then we had lunch, and finally we went home.' What did they do first?
You hear: 'A dog followed me home yesterday.' What is the story about?

objectives.can_do: I can hold a natural conversation about my past, my plans and everyday situations.
objectives.title: Conversación final A2
concepts: review: past, future, travel, health, stories

activities.instruction: Have a conversation with the tutor about a past experience and a future plan.
activities.target: A2 level conversation

activities.instruction: Without looking, say three things you can now talk about at A2 level.
activities.target: past experiences / future plans / everyday situations

activities.instruction: Talk about a completely new situation using everything you learned at A2.
activities.target: A2 level conversation in a new context

options: I went to London last year and I had a great time.
I go to London last year and I had a great time.
I went to London last year and I have a great time.
I am going to visit my family next week.
I am visit my family next week.
I going to visit my family next week.

checks.prompt: Listen: 'I had a headache, so I went to bed early.' What did she do?
Listen: 'We're going to visit Rome next summer.' When are they going?
